To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Computational Methods is a new way of teaching digital tools in the context of design thinking.
Computational Methods is an effective way to introduce computational thinking in design and it can be used to teach design computing.

Computational Methods is a course that introduces students to computational design thinking, and that computational thinking is a way of thinking that involves solving complex problems by breaking them down into smaller parts, and by thinking creatively to find solutions.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of computation and technology in design education and practice.
the role of computational thinking in the design process.
how computational thinking may be used in design and how it can be used as an innovative approach for teaching digital tools.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the integration of computational thinking in architecture education is a necessity.
the course introduces students to computational design methods and thinking as a way of design, not as a collection or specific tools.
the role of computational thinking is not only to teach the students how to use the tools but also to teach the students to develop new tools, methods, and techniques.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are teaching computational methods as an innovative way of thinking about the design process.
computational thinking is a new way to think and design, which can be taught in architecture schools.
we are teaching "Thinking Design Computing" and "Computational Design Thinking" to our students.
The main takeaway from our work is that
computational thinking can be introduced as a way to explore and develop new ways of thinking and doing.
computational methods are not only a set of tools, but also an innovative way of thinking about and solving design problems.
computation is an important part of the design process and that students need to understand the fundamentals of computation to be successful in their future careers.
